question: Sir Michael O’ Dwyer was the Lieutenant Governor of Punjab when the Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred in Amritsar in 1919. Who among the following killed him after 21 years of the incident?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Udham Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Sardar Udham Singh was an Indian revolutionary who assassinated Sir Michael O’Dwyer on **13 March 1940** in London.
 
• The assassination was carried out as an act of revenge for the **Jallianwala Bagh massacre** that occurred in Amritsar in **1919**.
 
• Sir Michael O’Dwyer was the Lieutenant Governor of Punjab at the time of the massacre, where British troops killed hundreds of unarmed civilians.
 
• Udham Singh was arrested immediately after the assassination and later hanged on **31 July 1940** at Pentonville Prison in London.
 
• Sardar Udham Singh is regarded as a martyr and a symbol of India's struggle for independence.
